{{Youmay|the Cularin hotel room|the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's Suite]], a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] office complex}}
{{Quote|If you believe my offer merits further consideration, please contact me at the Reidi Artom Luxury Resort here in Gadrin. I am in the Chancellor's suite.|Yarian Kak, to the [[Heroes of Cularin]]|<ref name="Quarters">{{LivingForce|Blinking Eyes: Quarters}}</ref>}}
The '''Chancellor's suite''' was a room that was located inside the [[Reidi Artom Luxury Resort]], a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] situated in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] trade advocate [[Yarian Kak]] visited Gadrin and stayed in the Chancellor's suite.
